content:
Maya: Prospect Nimbus wants a quick migration POC from VendorX. Core asks: API compatibility (minimal client change), prompt parity on 6 templates, billing translation, and security questionnaire with CMK options. Can we scope a tiny demo?
Diego: I can prototype an adapter that accepts VendorX payloads and returns VendorX-shaped responses. Will support header `X-VendorX-Session` -> map to `conversation_id`.
Priya: Secure requirements: SOC2, IP allowlist, customer-managed KMS preferred, audit logs, and retention controls. Also a question about PII redaction.
Maya: Timeline: they want a demo Thu. Can we have runnable artifacts by Wed EOD?
Diego: Wed EOD is tight but doable for a prototype: adapter + 6 prompt diffs + curl demo. Adapter will include a toggle for `logprobs` compatibility (default off).
Priya: Note: returning `logprobs` might be flagged as sensitive. I'll prepare two answers: hosted (restricted) vs Dedicated/Private (allowed).
Diego: Billing: VendorX bills in 50-token buckets. I'll run their sample logs through a conversion script to show per-token cost and delta.
Maya: Action items: Diego -> adapter repo + demo curl. Priya -> security Q answers and KMS path. Diego/Chris -> parity diffs. Drop artifacts here when done.
sec-bot: Reminder: CMK for hosted customers requires security approval. See internal runbook.
Maya: Example curl for demo:
```
curl -X POST https://demo.redwood/compat/vendorx \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer demo-token" \
  -H "X-VendorX-Session: sess-01" \
  -d '{"input":"Summarize our Q1 wins","max_tokens":60}'
```
Response will mimic VendorX shape and include `usage.total_tokens` to aid their billing UI.
Diego: Will surface latency impact (adapter adds ~10ms on cache hit). Will attach quick numbers.
Maya: Thanks team — please post links. :thumbsup:
